about: Which checks cover which files. node checks/run.mjs --changed reads this; a file no rule matches runs everything. Smoke entries are pieces of a section title in checks/smoke-shell.mjs (node checks/smoke-parallel.mjs --list shows them); "*" is every section, or every Node check.

model.covers: schema v4, migration, saved-resume files, every recipe byte-identical to before 0.5.1, render hash inputs

store.covers: undo, autosave, folder mirror, backup, checkpoints

paginate.covers: block pagination, Fit on the last page, labels, photo, fields

shell.covers: layout maths (sidebar, rail, page centred, pages side by side, a phone), what a click on each printed text selects, Esc, folder read back

camera.covers: the canvas camera: limits, the magnet, which page is bright, the spring

edit.covers: version numbers, edits, off/keep, sections, 300 random edits

motion.covers: motion rules: tokens, one reduced-motion rule, nothing blocks, the thirteen moments wired

direct.covers: the model behind editing on the page: cut-off, parked edits, lines only on one resume, every printed text as an edit with its base, headings, a language's name, the lock on every function that changes locked content, hiding a block that holds a lock, a reset layout, stale locks, a restore, the record's own edits, the Review list's model (a sub-version copies the source, a new major or claim needs one, Update changes the nearest version and the other resumes see newer wording, headings and names, a line only here becomes a claim, one undo step)

review-model.covers: the Review list's model: no draft or archived version as a parent or pick, a duplicate keeps its held lines, an equal heading is not listed, highlights follow trimmed text, the other resumes an update or a heading change reaches

resumes.covers: autosave, snapshots and sends, frozen text, new, duplicate (a company and a role for a new job), compare, glance, folder

focus.covers: tags, plan = apply, Keep untouched, no job emptied

lang.covers: the ten languages, missing texts, switching, A4 formats

diff.covers: the merge engine on an edited copy of the example

import.covers: every kind of file, JSON Resume round trip, outside edits

savefile.covers: Save to file: format, record id, the ways a file meets this browser, conflict copies

export.covers: the HTML page, plain text, JSON Resume, pre-flight

tokens.covers: theme tokens: forms, refusals, DTCG round trip, contrast

career.covers: the record's model and forms, the checklist folds, job types, the Highlight lens

i18n.covers: every catalogue: keys, placeholders, plurals, markup, the review marker

tokens-built-in.covers: the built-in themes' token files are up to date

parts.covers: the panels' markup unchanged by the shared parts; a claim opened from the page or the checklist is one panel

measurement.covers: page-fill arithmetic, the data-section marker, the probe's coverage

version.covers: package.json, sw.js and CHANGELOG.md name the same version

name.covers: the old product name only in released changelog entries and kept identifiers (CI runs it on _site)

validate-data.covers: the schema guard on the example record

to-jsonresume.covers: the JSON Resume export still works

drink.covers: the app's own tokens in Tea and Coffee, contrast, no colour outside a token block

preload.covers: index.html preloads the modules shell.js imports, and sw.js caches them

csp.covers: Content-Security-Policy: same-origin only, no inline script, no outside fetch

preflight.covers: preflight refuses embedded image metadata and a prototypes/ folder

history-scan.covers: history-scan reads commit messages, authors and committers

private-files.covers: the private check files are found outside the repo, or not at all

prepush.covers: the pre-push hook refuses private content and dry-runs the site for main

agent.covers: the agent workflow on the example: claims, new-resume, refusals, fit, the keyword gap

fit.covers: Fit's invariants on a modelled page

flatpak.covers: the Flatpak files agree: id, version, sandbox, cargo sources, workflow

desktop.covers: the desktop staging copy list is whole

tauri-folder.covers: the Tauri folder object against a fake window.__TAURI__

i18n-review.covers: the translation review sheets: the CSV, and --apply on a temporary copy

runner.covers: this map's globs and plan, the smoke runner's sharding and merge

head-check.covers: place tabs, name card (no Fit, no Saved), name window and seam in ten languages, both drinks, three window sizes and compact: nothing covered, cut or overlapping; Fit and the page bars in Export only

menu-check.covers: the editor menu layout: no footer, Fit in Export and its chip, the page bars at the top of Export, n/m counts, open sections as containers, names that wrap in ten languages

symmetry-check.covers: show/hide as one pill and one wording on the chip, depth row, sections, jobs, lines, items and the photo (round trips), the lock and the pill alike at rest, the chip's tools shown without a hover, the pill on every job head, archived lines in the Outline, the Fit chip staying, the two '+ line' labels; stage 2: an off section kept in its row, the toast's Undo button, the tool beside the padlock (revert, remove a line, remove a skill group) and its lock hold, skill sets cleared and deleted, + group, Delete in the name window, deleting a sent copy, removing a language, and the phone's depth row and menus; a lock asks before deleting the open resume or a sent copy, Reset keeps an off section in place, Fit is held while a screen is open

review-check.covers: the Review list's layout in ten languages at 1280x720, 1470x832, 1920x1080 and on a phone: a row of every kind, a long source, the dialog inside the window, nothing cut, overlapping or pushed out

review-ui-check.covers: the Review list's behaviour: markup in a resume name is text, use all the newer wording, the select only chooses until Apply, a locked heading is not offered, Ctrl+S/O/P inside the dialog, a failed save keeps it open, newer wording alone does not open it from Save to file

room-check.covers: the sidebar and the layout around the page: hidden share of the body, nothing too wide, the page filling the height

places-check.covers: the three places: the tabs (Library, Editor, Career, aria-current), W E R and not while typing, Esc never changes place (Compare, a selected card, Career's menu, a written line), the address and Back and Forward (ids only), the landing for none, one and two or more resumes and #resume, each place's state, the seam in one spot, Tea's tags swinging in steps and resting, Coffee square and flat

screens-check.covers: what the three places hold: the Library's cards and cards per row at 1280, 1920 and 2560, select then open, the inspector, Use for a new job (a company is required, typed text kept), the growing page, the hover preview and its pages, the thumbnail cache, Compare with N and P, Career's docked entry with both scopes, search by a line, no bar, ten languages at three sizes

label-fit.covers: every language's resume headings fit the gutter; the app's labels fit the sidebar's narrowest width (316px)

garden-check.covers: the tea garden in Chromium (about two minutes)
